newsitem.title: USA: ADM orders, options covered hopper barges.
newsitem.headline: ADM orders, options covered hopper barges.

text.p: Archer Daniels Midland Co said Thursday it ordered 175 covered hopper barges with an option for several hundred additional barges that would be constructed as part of a continuous building program.
The capital investment for barges will replace older equipment as well as keep up with expanded demand, the agribusiness company said in a statement.
The new large capacity barges are designed for great efficiency, ADM said. Delivery of the first 175 barges is expected within the next 12 months.
Officials of ADM, which held its annual shareholders meeting today, were not immediately available to provide the value, recipient or other details of the orders and options.
